sloka: एवम् उक्तौ तु तौ वीरौ कबन्धेन नर ईश्वरौ ।गिरि प्रदरम् आसाद्य पावकम् विससर्जतुः ॥३-७२-१॥
transliteration: evam uktau tu tau vīrau kabandhena nara īśvarau ।giri pradaram āsādya pāvakam visasarjatuḥ ॥3-72-1॥

translations.english: Thus said by Kabandha, the two lords of men, the heroes reached a cave in the mountain and lighted the fire.
